about: The NPCs and locs that have an examine text, by type id. The texts are Jagex's words, so they aren't here: each gets a key in the dialogue file (examine.npc_<id>, examine.loc_<id>), which Sam fills from the Wiki (2026-10-25).
wiki says where on the Wiki the text is, when not the infobox of the page named after it; also lists other ids that show as this NPC (multi-NPCs, which the client may send either way).
Entries are sorted by id, one a line, so threads adding entries at once don't touch the same line; each area adds its own line to this list (CONTRIBUTING.md).
NPCs: those spawned in npc-spawns.
Locs: every named loc type in Lumbridge Castle and its cellar (the 241 cache, map squares 50,50 and 50,150), and those the rest of Lumbridge's content uses.

Locs: every named loc type outside the castle in the rest of Lumbridge (map squares 49 to 51 by 49 to 51, west of the Al Kharid fence at x 3268, every level; the 241 cache, 2026-10-30), keyed one per id until the Wiki shows ids sharing a text; also lists other ids that share the text.

Locs: every named loc type of the Varrock Museum (map square 50,53, x 3252 to 3267 and z 3441 to 3458, every level, but Varrock's own furniture and stairs; and the Natural History floor, map square 27,77; the 241 cache, 2026-11-02), keyed one per id; the doors list their open types.
NPCs: the Varrock Museum's six archaeologists (Kudos step 1), keyed one per id though the Wiki gives each the same text.
Locs: the Champions' Guild's own: its door (with its open type), the trapdoor to its basement (shut and open) and the basement's ladder up (the 241 cache, 2026-11-02).

Locs and NPCs: Agility (steps 1 to 8): every obstacle loc type of the Draynor Village, Al Kharid and Varrock rooftops, the Gnome Stronghold course and the six Misthalin shortcuts (skills/agility.json; names from the 241 cache, 2026-11-03), keyed one per id until the Wiki shows ids sharing a text; and Grace in the Rogues' Den.

Locs and NPCs: Draynor (step 16): every named loc type of map squares 48,49 to 48,52 (Draynor Village, its manor and the Wizards' Tower, x 3072 to 3135, every level), 48,149 and 48,150 (the tower's basement and Draynor Sewers), 48,152 (Draynor Manor's basement, its doors and levers keyed by their visible types with the map's multiloc ids under also) and 45,75 (the rune essence mine) that had none, with the mine's five portal types, which aren't on the map (the 241 cache, 2026-11-03), keyed one per id; and every NPC type the Draynor, manor, sewers and tower spawns use, with the types their multi-NPCs show.

Locs and NPCs: Edgeville, Barbarian Village and the land between (Edgeville piece step 15): every named loc type that had none on the surface from x 3030 to 3150 and z 3392 to 3519 (Edgeville, the monastery, Barbarian Village, the woods west of it and the land east to the Cooks' Guild, but not the Black Knights' Fortress), in Edgeville Dungeon and the Basement of Doom (x 3040 to 3150, z 9792 to 9919) and on the Stronghold of Security's four floors (map squares 29,81, 31,81, 33,82 and 36,81), every level (the 241 cache, 2026-11-03), keyed one per id; and every NPC type the edgeville, barbarian-village, cooks-guild, edgeville-dungeon and stronghold-of-security spawns use, with the types their multi-NPCs show.

Locs: Misthalin piece 7 step 1, the rest of Lumbridge Swamp: the stepping stone to the desert and the Water Altar's ruins (both types the ruins show; the 242 cache, 2026-11-09). Hewey, Abigale and the two goblin sergeants get none: after their quests the 242 cache never shows them.

Locs and NPCs: text review (2026-11-15): every NPC type the spawns use and every named loc type of the 89 map squares those spawns stand in (the 242 cache) that had none, where the Wiki gives that id one examine text (the infobox of the page in wiki, else of the page named after it), keyed one per id. Types the Wiki gives no text for, or more than one, get none yet.
Locs and NPCs: Hunter step 1: the five snared birds and every bird snare loc type (set, failing, failed, and each bird's struggling and caught types; the 242 cache), keyed one per id.

Locs and NPCs: Hunter step 2: the ferret, chinchompa and carnivorous chinchompa and every box trap loc type of theirs (set, failing, failed, each creature's caught type and its four struggling types; the 242 cache), keyed one per id.
Hunter step 3 (2026-11-15): the swamp lizards and salamanders of npc-spawns/hunter-net-traps.json, and the young trees and net traps in every state, from the Young tree and Net trap pages.
Hunter step 4 (2026-11-15): the kebbits of npc-spawns/hunter-deadfalls.json, and the deadfall's boulder in every state, from the Deadfall page.

Hunter step 5 (2026-11-15): the pitfall creatures of npc-spawns/hunter-pitfalls.json, and the pit, spiked pit and the big cats full pits from the Pitfall page. The falling-in form (19229, 19230) and the antelopes full pit (53024) have no Wiki text yet.
Hunter step 6a (2026-11-15): the butterflies and moths of npc-spawns/hunter-butterflies.json, from each creature page.
Hunter step 6b (2026-11-15): the Gielinor implings and the crystal impling's seventeen names, from each impling page (the baby impling's overworld version).
Hunter step 7 (2026-11-15): Matthias, the falcons on their prey and the falconry kebbits of npc-spawns/hunter-falconry.json, from each page.
Hunter step 9 (2026-11-15): the Hunter shops' keepers of npc-spawns/hunter-shops.json, from each page.

NPCs and locs: Wilderness step W2.5 (2026-11-15): the types piece 2 spawns and places that had none (the Edgeville Dungeon's Wilderness part, levels 1 to 20, Ferox Enclave), one per id, from the infobox of the page in wiki, else of the page named after it. Last Man Standing's host (7320, a multi-NPC) gets none until that minigame.
The raid tester (2026-11-16): npc-spawns/raid-tester.json's Leagues Tutor (316), a testing NPC with no live counterpart; his examine is our own words.

NPCs and locs: Wilderness step W3.8 (2026-11-15): the types piece 3 spawns (levels 21 to 56, the Lava Maze Dungeon, the Mage Arena bank) and the locs its content handles that had none, one per id, from the infobox of the page in wiki, else of the page named after it. None yet where the Wiki gives no text or more than one: the greater demons (2026 to 2029, red or purple), the Chaos Temple's noting Elder Chaos druid (7995), the Lava Maze's mirror ladders (18987 to 18990), the King Black Dragon's levers (1816, 1817).

NPCs and locs: Fight Caves step FC1 (2026-11-17): the Fight Cave's monsters (3116 to 3128), TzHaar-Mej-Jal (2180) and the cave's entrance and exit (11833, 11834), one per id, from the infobox of the page named after each (the cave's two locs share the Cave entrance page).
Locs and NPCs: Karamja (step K1.1): the Port Sarim to Musa Point boat's four NPCs, with the types their multi-NPCs show, and its two ships' gangplanks (the 242 cache, 2026-11-17).
Construction step CON1 (2026-11-18): the estate agent of npc-spawns/construction.json, the Rimmington house portal, the exit portal and the basic wood house doors.

NPCs: Inferno step IN4 (2026-11-17): the Zuk wave's Jal-Xil, Jal-Zek, JalTok-Jad and Yt-HurKot (7702 to 7705), the moving Ancestral Glyph (7707) and the Jal-MejJak (7708), from the infobox of the page named after each.

NPCs and locs: Inferno step IN1 (2026-11-17): the Inferno's monsters (7691 to 7701, 7706), TzHaar-Ket-Keh as each of his forms shows (11247, 11248), the Inferno's entrance as it shows (30281, 30282: the Wiki has no page for it, so no words yet), its exit (30283) and the rocky supports' four looks (30284 to 30287), one per id, from the infobox of the page named after each.
The Clan Hub (2026-11-19): npc-spawns/clan-hub.json's Clerk (10759), from the Clerk (Clan Hub) page.
NPCs and locs: Karamja (step K1.2): Musa Point's Luthas, Zembo and general store keeper and assistant, and the banana trees as they lose their fruit (the 242 cache, 2026-11-17).
